section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study (Study X) that adapted and validated the Brazilian version of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) for adolescents aged 10-13 years. The study confirmed the original unidimensional factor structure of the BAS with 13 items and demonstrated satisfactory internal consistency (α = .804), concurrent validity through negative associations with BMI and positive associations with body satisfaction, and significant differences between normal-weight and overweight groups. The research was conducted in both private and public schools in Brazil, with participants from ethnically diverse backgrounds.
